PayPal Debit Card-funded domestic personal sends cost $0.

applied.quote: PayPal charges 2.90% + $0.30 for domestic personal sends funded by either type of card.
applied.replacement: PayPal charges 2.90% + $0.30 for domestic personal sends funded by a credit card or a debit card other than the PayPal Debit Card.
applied.why: PayPal Debit Card-funded domestic personal sends cost $0.

applied.quote: The [credit card cash advance guide](/guides/credit-card-cash-advance-guide/) covers another cost to consider when funding a payment with credit.
applied.replacement: For more on cash advances, see the [credit card cash advance guide](/guides/credit-card-cash-advance-guide/).
applied.why: SOURCE does not connect credit-funded payments to cash-advance costs.

applied.quote: Zelle is the closest fit when the job is getting a domestic personal payment straight into a bank account.
applied.replacement: Zelle sends domestic personal payments directly between eligible bank accounts.
applied.why: SOURCE does not rank Zelle as the closest fit.

applied.quote: Funding a domestic personal send with a credit or debit card instead costs 2.90% + $0.30.
applied.replacement: Funding a domestic personal send with a credit card or a debit card other than the PayPal Debit Card costs 2.90% + $0.30.
applied.why: PayPal Debit Card-funded domestic personal sends cost $0.

applied.quote: A debit-card-funded domestic personal send instead costs $0 on Venmo and 2.90% + $0.30 on PayPal, so the cheaper choice changes with the funding method.
applied.replacement: A domestic personal send funded by a debit card other than the PayPal Debit Card costs $0 on Venmo and 2.90% + $0.30 on PayPal, so the cheaper choice changes with the funding method.
applied.why: PayPal Debit Card-funded domestic personal sends also cost $0.

applied.quote: PayPal's card-funded personal-send fee and identical instant-withdrawal rate limit its appeal as a blanket lower-cost replacement for Venmo.
applied.replacement: PayPal charges for credit-card and other debit-card-funded personal sends and has the same instant-withdrawal fee schedule as Venmo.
applied.why: SOURCE does not assess PayPal’s appeal, and its Debit Card sends are free.

applied.quote: Fits people comparing cross-currency costs, while Venmo remains simpler for domestic sends among people without Wise accounts and has a $0 debit card and $0 withdrawals at US MoneyPass ATMs.
applied.replacement: Fits people comparing cross-currency costs, while Venmo offers $0 eligible domestic personal sends, a $0 debit card and $0 withdrawals at US MoneyPass ATMs.
applied.why: SOURCE does not call Venmo simpler.

applied.quote: - Sellers choosing an account for business funds need more than payment-processing rates.
applied.replacement: - Compare business accounts separately from payment-processing rates.
applied.why: SOURCE does not state what sellers need to choose a business account.

applied.quote: - People choosing among international currency services beyond Wise and Xoom need a wider comparison.
applied.replacement: - To consider international currency services beyond Wise and Xoom, use a wider comparison.
applied.why: SOURCE does not state what those people need.

applied.quote: Square's per-location subscription also matters at higher payment volume.
applied.replacement: Square's per-location subscription and card rates both affect the total at a given payment volume.
applied.why: SOURCE lists plan prices and rates but no volume threshold for their importance.

applied.quote: The [financial product comparison hub](/compare/) has other comparisons organized around the terms that change a bill.
applied.replacement: See the [financial product comparison hub](/compare/) for other comparisons.
applied.why: SOURCE identifies the hub but does not describe how its comparisons are organized.

applied.quote: Unlike Apple Cash, Venmo is not limited to Apple devices.
applied.replacement: Apple Cash works only on Apple devices.
applied.why: The closed fact list states Apple Cash’s device limit, not Venmo’s device support.

applied.quote: Venmo charges $0 for eligible domestic personal sends funded by a debit card, while PayPal applies its card-funded personal-send fee to debit cards.
applied.replacement: Venmo charges $0 for eligible domestic personal sends funded by a debit card, while PayPal charges 2.90% + $0.30 when funded by a debit card other than the PayPal Debit Card.
applied.why: PayPal Debit Card-funded domestic personal sends cost $0.

applied.quote: That structure avoids Venmo's 1.75% instant cash-out fee, but it also means Zelle cannot fund a payment with a credit card or send money internationally.
applied.replacement: Zelle has no 1.75% instant cash-out fee; it also cannot fund a payment with a credit card or send money internationally.
applied.why: SOURCE lists these constraints but does not attribute them to Zelle’s bank-to-bank structure.

applied.quote: A payment can be canceled only while the recipient has not enrolled, which makes the recipient's details especially important before sending.
applied.replacement: A payment can be canceled only while the recipient has not enrolled.
applied.why: SOURCE states the cancellation rule, not the added evaluation of recipient details.
